public_rationale: The available measures do not settle the claim on a consistent commercial basis. Ramp shows concentrated spending, not a majority of customers being startups. Google reports substantial consumer reach, which matters under a broader reading, but monthly users cannot be substituted for paying customers. Neither the full competitive comparison nor the customer-composition assertion is established.
limitations: The outcome depends on how customers and growth are defined.
A broad consumer-user reading faces stronger counterevidence than the commercial reading used here.
Named large enterprise customers alone cannot disprove a startup majority.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: No other AI companies are growing anywhere near as fast as Anthropic and OpenAI or have customer bases that come close to theirs, and those customers are mostly other AI startups.

statement.excerpt: There are no other AI companies that are growing anywhere near as fast or have customer bases that come close to Anthropic and OpenAI, and those customers are mostly other AI startups.

from_speaker: those customers are mostly other AI startups
our_interpretation: In this discussion of business viability, customers means paying customers; free consumer users are not automatically comparable.
Those customers refers to the customers of OpenAI and Anthropic. Mostly means more than half by customer count, not by revenue.
The preceding discussion of revenue run rates makes commercial revenue growth the natural growth measure. Realized revenue and annualized run rates must be compared separately.
The comparison includes businesses selling competing AI services, including AI businesses within larger companies, but excludes their unrelated operations.
Use July through September 2026, the latest completed calendar quarter before the post, for the ongoing observation. Customer counts can be snapshots within that quarter.
No accounting basis, growth interval, or numerical meaning of close is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable industry data establish a clear growth and paying-customer gap separating both labs from competitors, and representative customer classifications show that AI startups comprise more than half of each lab's customers.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish a competitor with similar commercial growth or customer scale, or representative customer classifications establish that AI startups are not a majority of the relevant customer base.
